newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Bank Canada Q2 loan losses fall.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank Canada Q2 loan losses fall.

text.p: The Royal Bank of Canada said on Wednesday that its provision for credit losses in the second quarter fell 14 percent to C$95 million from C$110 million in the previous year.
As a percentage of average loans and bankers' acceptances, the provision was 0.26 percent this quarter, better than the bank's target of 0.34 percent for this year.

Net impaired loans were C$220 million, a decline or improvement of C$67 million or 23 percent from last quarter. They represented 0.1 percent of total loans and bankers' acceptances at April 30, 1997 compared to 0.2 percent a quarter ago.
